desc:
🍂 Welcome to Would You Rather: Autumn Contest Outfit Tower! 🍁
Choose a door and build your perfect fall outfit one choice at a time. ♡
🏆 OUTFIT CONTEST
Reach the top and compete against other players! Show off your final look, vote for your favorites, and see who created the BEST OUTFIT! 👑

Every doorway gives you something new:
🧸 Cozy autumn outfits, hair & accessories
🎀 Cute and trendy seasonal items
💀 Or something that could completely RUIN your outfit!

Climb through autumn-themed towers, make your choices, and create a different look every run!
🍁 New choices = new outfits every time!
🌸 Play again, try new styles & win more contests!
🎵 Features aesthetic music and cozy autumn decoration
💗 LIKE + FAVORITE for more outfits, themes & updates!
